newsitem.title: MEXICO: GMexico wins $50 mln in copper financing.
newsitem.headline: GMexico wins $50 mln in copper financing.

text.p: Mexico's largest mining company Grupo Mexico (GMexico) said Wednesday it has been given $50 million in financing from the Export Development Corporation.
In a statement published in newspapers, GMexico said the money was in support of the company's expansion of its La Caridad copper smelter.
GMexico is in the process of expanding La Caridad to have an anuual capacity of 300,000 tonnes from 180,000 tonnes.
